admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: Moderation, payouts and the ledger arrive in the admin phase.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Use an API key to call the REST, GraphQL and gRPC APIs from your own scripts. Each key only does what its scopes allow.
keys.name: Name
keys.name_hint: Something that tells you where the key is used, like "Inventory script".
keys.created_body: This is the only time "{name}" is shown. Store it in a password manager or a secret store; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
keys.empty: No keys yet. Create one above to start calling the API.
keys.revoke_confirm: Revoke "{name}"? Anything using it stops working immediately.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions, partnership ideas or a problem with an order? Send us a message and we will get back to you by email.
contact.name: Your name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.sent: Thanks! Your message was sent. We will reply by email.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Get an HTTPS POST, signed with the Standard Webhooks scheme, whenever something happens in your shop.
webhooks.no_shop: Open a shop first to receive webhooks.
webhooks.url_hint: Public HTTPS URL. Private and local addresses are refused.
webhooks.secret_body: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. Use it to verify the webhook-signature header.
webhooks.delete_confirm: Delete this endpoint? Pending deliveries to it stop.

errors.url_invalid: Enter a valid URL without credentials.
errors.url_internal: The URL points to a private or local address.
errors.limit: You can have at most {max} endpoints.
